title: to be: I am / you are / we are / they are
title_uz: To be: I am, you are, we are, they are
rule_uz: Salom! "To be" fe'li "bo'lmoq" ma'nosini beradi. Kim ekanimizni, qayerdaligimizni va yoshimizni aytganda ishlatamiz. I bilan am, you bilan are, we bilan are, they bilan are ishlatiladi. Qisqa shakllari: I'm, you're, we're, they're.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: My friends ___ at the park now.

title: to be: he is / she is / it is
title_uz: To be: he is, she is, it is
rule_uz: He, she va it bilan "to be" fe'lining is shakli ishlatiladi. He - o'g'il bola yoki erkak, she - qiz bola yoki ayol, it - narsa yoki hayvon uchun. Bitta odam yoki narsa haqida gapirsak ham is deymiz: Ali is, the book is. Qisqa shakllari: he's, she's, it's.

mistakes.note_uz: He bilan are emas, is ishlatiladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: Look at the bag. ___ is red.
My brother is tall. ___ is also kind.

title: to be: negatives and questions, short answers
title_uz: To be: inkor, savol va qisqa javob
rule_uz: Inkor gapda to be fe'lidan keyin not qo'yamiz: I am not, he is not (isn't), they are not (aren't). Savol tuzish uchun to be fe'lini gap boshiga olib chiqamiz: Are you ready? Is she a doctor? Qisqa javob: Yes, I am. / No, he isn't. Qisqa javobda fe'lni takrorlaymiz, lekin gapni to'liq aytmaymiz.
forms: I am not / you aren't / he isn't
Am I...? Are you...? Is she...?
Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
Yes, it is. / No, it isn't.

examples.en: She is not at school today.
Is it a dog? No, it isn't.

mistakes.wrong: Are you a student? Yes, I do.
mistakes.right: Are you a student? Yes, I am.
mistakes.note_uz: Savolda are bo'lsa, javobda ham am/are ishlatiladi.
Inkor uchun to be dan keyin not qo'yiladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: I ___ not a teacher. I am a student.

title: a / an
rule_uz: A va an "bitta" ma'nosini beradi va sanash mumkin bo'lgan bitta narsa oldidan keladi. Undosh tovush bilan boshlansa a ishlatamiz: a book, a dog. Unli tovush (a, e, i, o, u) bilan boshlansa an ishlatamiz: an apple, an egg. Diqqat: tovushga qaraymiz, harfga emas! University so'zi "yu" tovushi bilan boshlanadi, shuning uchun a university.
forms: a + undosh: a pen, a cat
an + unli: an egg, an orange

examples.en: She eats an apple every day.
examples.uz: U har kuni bitta olma yeydi.

mistakes.note_uz: Apple unli tovush bilan boshlanadi, shuning uchun an.
Dog undosh bilan boshlanadi, shuning uchun a.

title: plural nouns (-s, -es, -ies)
rule_uz: Bir narsadan ko'p bo'lsa, otning oxiriga -s qo'shamiz: book - books. Ot -s, -x, -ch, -sh bilan tugasa -es qo'shamiz: box - boxes, watch - watches. Ot undosh + y bilan tugasa, y ni olib tashlab -ies yozamiz: baby - babies. Unli + y bilan tugasa oddiy -s qo'shiladi: monkey - monkeys.

examples.en: There are three boxes on the table.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: There are three ___ on the table.
She has three ___ in her bag.
There are many ___ in the zoo.

title: irregular plurals (child-children, man-men)
rule_uz: Ba'zi otlarning ko'pligi -s bilan yasalmaydi, ularni yodlash kerak. Masalan: child - children, man - men, woman - women, foot - feet, tooth - teeth, mouse - mice. Bu so'zlar bilan -s qo'shmaymiz: childs emas, children! Fish so'zi odatda ham birlikda, ham ko'plikda fish bo'ladi.

examples.en: There are ten children in my class.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: There are ten ___ in my class.

title: this / that / these / those
rule_uz: Ishora qilganda this, that, these, those ishlatamiz. This (bu) - yaqindagi bitta narsa, these (bular) - yaqindagi bir nechta narsa. That (u) - uzoqdagi bitta narsa, those (ular) - uzoqdagi bir nechta narsa. Bitta narsa bo'lsa is, ko'p bo'lsa are keladi: This is a pen. These are pens.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: (Over there) Look at ___ birds in the tree!

title: subject pronouns and possessive adjectives (my, your, his, her, our, their)
rule_uz: Gapda kim ish qilayotganini I, you, he, she, it, we, they aytadi. Narsa kimniki ekanini my, your, his, her, our, their bildiradi. Ular otdan oldin keladi: my bag, her book, their house. I - my, you - your, he - his, she - her, we - our, they - their. It ning egalik shakli its.
forms: he - his, she - her, it - its

examples.en: She is my sister. Her name is Nodira.
examples.uz: U mening opam. Uning ismi Nodira.

examples.en: They have a dog. Their dog is big.
examples.uz: Ularning iti bor. Ularning iti katta.

mistakes.wrong: She is Dilya. His bag is blue.
mistakes.right: She is Dilya. Her bag is blue.

mistakes.note_uz: Ot oldidan I emas, my keladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: Ali is my friend. ___ is ten.
This is Dilya. ___ bag is blue.
My parents are teachers. ___ are kind.
We love ___ dog. It is very small.
Tom and Sara have a cat. ___ cat is black.

title: possessive 's (Ali's book)
rule_uz: Narsa kimgadir tegishli ekanini aytish uchun otga 's qo'shamiz: Ali's book - Alining kitobi. Egasi birinchi, narsa keyin turadi. The cat's ball - mushukning to'pi. Children, men kabi qoidasiz ko'plikdagi otlarga ham 's qo'shiladi: the children's toys. Savolga javobda ham ishlatsa bo'ladi: Whose bike is it? It's Ali's.

examples.en: The children's toys are in the box.

mistakes.wrong: This is the book of Ali.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: The ___ toys are in the box.

title: there is / there are (+ negatives, questions)
rule_uz: Biror joyda nima borligini aytish uchun there is va there are ishlatamiz. Bitta narsa bo'lsa there is, bir nechta bo'lsa there are deymiz. Inkor: there isn't, there aren't. Savol: Is there...? Are there...? Javob: Yes, there is. / No, there aren't. Ko'plikda any so'zi ko'p ishlatiladi.

examples.en: There is a book on the desk.
There are three cats in the garden.
Is there a park near your house?

mistakes.note_uz: Ikkita narsa uchun there are ishlatiladi.
Bitta narsa uchun there is ishlatiladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: There ___ a book on the desk.
There ___ three cats in the garden.
There ___ a park near my house.
There ___ a cat under the table, only a dog.
___ there a swimming pool in your school?
"Are there any pens in your bag?" "Yes, there ___."

title: have got / has got
rule_uz: Bizda biror narsa borligini aytish uchun have got yoki has got ishlatamiz. I, you, we, they bilan have got, he, she, it bilan has got. Inkor: haven't got, hasn't got. Savol uchun Have / Has ni gap boshiga qo'yamiz: Have you got a pen? Has he got a bike? Qisqa shakllari: I've got, she's got.
forms: I / you / we / they + have got
Have you got...? Has she got...?

examples.en: I have got a new bike.

title: can / can't (ability)
rule_uz: Can biror ishni qila olishimizni bildiradi. Can't (cannot) esa qila olmaslikni bildiradi. Can dan keyin fe'l o'zgarmaydi, -s ham qo'shilmaydi: She can swim. Savol uchun can ni gap boshiga olamiz: Can you ride a bike? Javob: Yes, I can. / No, I can't.
forms: I / you / he / we / they + can + fe'l
Yes, I can. / No, I can't.

examples.en: My little brother can't read yet.

mistakes.note_uz: Can dan keyin to kerak emas.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: My little brother is two. He ___ read yet.

title: imperatives (Sit down! Don't run!)
rule_uz: Buyruq gap bilan biror ishni qilishni aytamiz yoki so'raymiz. Buning uchun fe'lning oddiy shaklini gap boshiga qo'yamiz: Sit down! Open your book! Xushmuomala bo'lish uchun please deymiz. "Qilmang" deyish uchun fe'ldan oldin Don't qo'yamiz: Don't run! "Bo'l" deyish uchun Be ishlatamiz: Be quiet!
forms: Please + fe'l: Please open the door.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: Please ___ the door. It is cold.
___ quiet, please! The baby is sleeping.

title: present simple: I / you / we / they
title_uz: Hozirgi oddiy zamon: I, you, we, they
rule_uz: Har kuni yoki tez-tez qiladigan ishlarimiz haqida gapirganda Present Simple ishlatamiz. I, you, we, they bilan fe'lning oddiy shaklini aytamiz, hech narsa qo'shmaymiz: I play, they eat. Bu zamon bilan every day, on Sundays, in the morning kabi so'zlar ko'p ishlatiladi.
forms: every day, on Sundays, in the morning

examples.uz: Men har kuni ertalab sut ichaman.

examples.en: We go to school by bus.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: My friends and I ___ pizza on Fridays.
The children ___ to music after school.

title: present simple: he / she / it (-s, -es)
title_uz: Hozirgi oddiy zamon: he, she, it
rule_uz: He, she, it bilan Present Simple da fe'lga -s qo'shamiz: she reads, he plays. Fe'l -s, -sh, -ch, -x, -o bilan tugasa -es qo'shamiz: watch - watches, go - goes. Undosh + y bilan tugasa y o'rniga -ies yozamiz: study - studies. Have fe'li alohida: he has.
forms: He / she / it + fe'l + s: he plays

examples.en: My dad drinks coffee in the morning.
The dog has a long tail.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: My dad ___ coffee in the morning.
My mother ___ TV in the evening.

title: present simple negative (don't / doesn't)
rule_uz: Biror ishni qilmasak, don't yoki doesn't ishlatamiz. I, you, we, they bilan don't yoziladi. He, she, it bilan doesn't yoziladi. Don't va doesn't dan keyin fe'l oddiy holida keladi, -s qo'shilmaydi: She doesn't like fish.
forms: I / you / we / they + don't + play

examples.en: We don't have school on Sunday.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: Tom doesn't ___ TV in the morning.
The dog doesn't ___ in the house.

title: present simple questions (Do / Does) and short answers
rule_uz: Savol berish uchun gapning boshiga Do yoki Does qo'yamiz. I, you, we, they bilan Do ishlatamiz. He, she, it bilan Does ishlatamiz. Does dan keyin fe'lga -s qo'shilmaydi: Does she play tennis? Qisqa javob: Yes, I do. / No, she doesn't.
forms: Do + I / you / we / they + play?
Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
Yes, she does. / No, she doesn't.

examples.en: Does your brother play the guitar?
Do they walk to school? No, they don't.
examples.uz: Ular maktabga piyoda boradimi? Yo'q, bormaydi.

mistakes.note_uz: Does dan keyin fe'l oddiy holida turadi.
He, she, it bilan Does kerak.

title: question words: what, where, who, when, how, why
rule_uz: So'roq so'zlar bilan ko'proq ma'lumot so'raymiz. What - nima, where - qayerda, who - kim, when - qachon, how - qanday, why - nima uchun. So'roq so'z gapning boshida turadi: Where do you live? Why ga because bilan javob beramiz.

examples.en: Why are you happy? Because it is my birthday.
examples.uz: Nega xursandsan? Chunki bugun tug'ilgan kunim.

mistakes.note_uz: So'roq so'zdan keyin do / does yoki is / are kerak.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: ___ is that boy? He is my brother.
___ is your birthday? It is in May.
"___ are you crying?" "Because I am sad."

title: adverbs of frequency (always, usually, sometimes, never)
rule_uz: Biror ish qanchalik tez-tez bo'lishini aytish uchun always, usually, often, sometimes, never ishlatamiz. Always - doim, never - hech qachon. Ular odatda asosiy fe'ldan oldin turadi: I always eat breakfast. Am, is, are dan keyin keladi: She is never late.
forms: I / you / we / they + always + play
I am / He is + never + late

examples.en: I always brush my teeth before bed.
examples.uz: Men uxlashdan oldin doim tish yuvaman.

examples.en: My brother sometimes plays computer games.
We never eat in the classroom.
examples.uz: Biz sinfda hech qachon ovqat yemaymiz.

mistakes.note_uz: Is / am / are dan keyin never qo'yiladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: My mum cooks dinner every day. She ___ cooks dinner.
I ___ eat ice cream, but not every day.
Ali ___ brushes his teeth in the morning. He does it every day.
Anna ___ late for school. She always comes on time.
They ___ play chess on Fridays. It is their hobby.

title: prepositions of place (in, on, under, next to, behind, between)
rule_uz: Narsa qayerda turganini aytish uchun joy predloglarini ishlatamiz. In - ichida, on - ustida, under - tagida, next to - yonida, behind - orqasida, between - ikkisining o'rtasida. Bular is / are dan keyin keladi: The cat is under the table.
forms: in = ichida; on = ustida; under = tagida
between A and B = A va B o'rtasida

examples.en: The pencil is in my bag.
The cat is under the chair.
The school is between the park and the shop.

mistakes.wrong: The book is in the desk. (partaning ustida)
mistakes.right: The book is on the desk.
mistakes.note_uz: Narsa sirtda tursa on, ichida bo'lsa in.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: The book is ___ the desk. I can see it on top.
My bag is ___ my chair, on the floor below it.
Our house is ___ the shop and the school.
Ali sits ___ Dilya. They are neighbours.
The bus stop is ___ the school, at the back of it.

title: prepositions of time (at, on, in)
rule_uz: Vaqt haqida gapirganda at, on, in ishlatamiz. At - aniq soat va tun bilan: at 7 o'clock, at night. On - hafta kunlari va sanalar bilan: on Monday, on 5th May. In - oylar, fasllar, yillar va kun qismlari bilan: in July, in winter, in the morning.
forms: at + soat: at 8 o'clock, at night
on + kun: on Monday, on my birthday
in + oy / fasl / yil: in May, in summer, in 2024

examples.uz: Bizda seshanba kuni ingliz tili bor.

examples.en: It is very cold in January.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: I have a swimming class ___ Tuesday.
We have a party ___ Saturday evening.

title: like / love / hate + noun and + -ing
rule_uz: Nimani yoqtirishimiz yoki yoqtirmasligimizni aytish uchun like, love, hate ishlatamiz. Like - yoqtirmoq, love - juda yaxshi ko'rmoq, hate - yoqtirmaslik. Ulardan keyin ot yoki fe'l+ing keladi: I like pizza. I love swimming. He, she, it bilan -s qo'shiladi: She hates noise.
forms: I / you / we / they + like + noun

exercises.sentence_with_blank: Tom ___ cold milk. He never drinks it.

title: object pronouns (me, you, him, her, it, us, them)
rule_uz: Fe'ldan yoki predlogdan keyin me, you, him, her, it, us, them ishlatamiz. I o'rniga me, he o'rniga him, she o'rniga her, we o'rniga us, they o'rniga them. Masalan: Help me! I like her. Look at them.
forms: he - him, she - her, it - it

examples.en: My teacher helps me with English.
examples.uz: O'qituvchim menga ingliz tilida yordam beradi.

examples.en: I know him. He is in my class.
examples.uz: Men uni bilaman. U mening sinfimda o'qiydi.

examples.en: Look at them! They are dancing.

mistakes.note_uz: Fe'ldan keyin he emas, him ishlatiladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: Sara is my friend. I play with ___ every day.
Look at the dog. Give ___ some water.
These are my shoes. Do you like ___?
I have a question. Please listen to ___.
Mum, can you help ___? My sister and I need some help.

title: some / any
rule_uz: Some va any - "bir oz" yoki "bir nechta" degan ma'noni beradi. Darak gaplarda some ishlatamiz: I have some apples. Inkor gaplarda va savollarda any ishlatamiz: I don't have any apples. Do you have any apples? Taklif qilganda some ishlatiladi: Would you like some tea?
forms: - not any: I don't have any books.
? any: Do you have any books?

examples.en: There are some oranges on the table.
examples.uz: Stol ustida bir nechta apelsin bor.

examples.en: Is there any juice in the fridge?

exercises.sentence_with_blank: Is there ___ milk in the fridge?
There aren't ___ chairs in the room.
She didn't buy ___ eggs, but she bought some milk.

title: countable and uncountable nouns: how much / how many
rule_uz: Bir, ikki, uch deb sanaladigan narsalar - sanaladigan otlar: apple, book. Sanab bo'lmaydigan narsalar - sanalmaydigan otlar: water, milk, rice, sugar. Sanaladigan otlar bilan how many ishlatamiz: How many eggs? Sanalmaydigan otlar bilan how much ishlatamiz: How much milk?

examples.en: How many books do you have?
How much water do you drink?
We need some rice for lunch.

mistakes.wrong: How much apples do you want?
mistakes.right: How many apples do you want?
mistakes.note_uz: Apples sanaladi, shuning uchun how many.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: How ___ water is in the bottle?
How ___ students are in your class?
How ___ sugar do you need for the cake?

title: present continuous (I am running)
rule_uz: Hozir, shu payt davom etayotgan ish haqida gapirganda Present Continuous ishlatamiz. Shakli: am / is / are + fe'l+ing. I bilan am, he / she / it bilan is, we / you / they bilan are ishlatiladi. Look! va Listen! so'zlari ko'pincha shu zamonni bildiradi.

examples.en: I am reading a book now.
The children are playing in the park.

mistakes.note_uz: Is / am / are dan keyin fe'lga -ing qo'shiladi.
Qisqa fe'lda oxirgi undosh ikkita yoziladi: running.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: Look! The children ___ in the park.

title: present continuous vs present simple
rule_uz: Present Simple odatlar va doimiy ishlar haqida: I go to school every day. Present Continuous esa hozir bo'layotgan ish haqida: I am going to school now. Every day, usually, always so'zlari Present Simple bilan keladi. Now, at the moment, Look!, Listen! so'zlari Present Continuous bilan keladi.
forms: usually, always, every day + Present Simple
now, at the moment, Look! + Present Continuous

examples.en: I usually walk to school, but today I am taking the bus.
examples.uz: Men odatda maktabga piyoda boraman, lekin bugun avtobusda ketyapman.

examples.en: My dad works in a bank.
Be quiet! The baby is sleeping.

mistakes.note_uz: Hozir bo'layotgan ish uchun is raining.

mistakes.wrong: I am going to school every day.
mistakes.right: I go to school every day.
mistakes.note_uz: Every day odat bildiradi, shuning uchun Present Simple.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: I usually ___ to school by bus.
Today I ___ to school by car.
My father ___ at a bank every day.
Ali ___ his teeth now, so he can't answer the phone.

title: adjectives before nouns; very + adjective
rule_uz: Sifat narsaning qanday ekanini aytadi: big, small, red, happy. Ingliz tilida sifat otdan oldin turadi: a red car (qizil mashina). Sifat hech qachon -s qo'shmaydi: two small dogs. Very sifatdan oldin qo'yilsa, ma'no kuchayadi: very big - juda katta.
forms: a / an + sifat + ot: a big dog
sifat + ko'plik ot: two small dogs

exercises.sentence_with_blank: The soup is ___ hot. Be careful!
That is a ___ film. I laughed a lot.

title: want to / would like to
rule_uz: Biror narsani xohlasak, want to ishlatamiz: I want to play. Nazokatli aytish uchun would like to deymiz: I would like to have some water. He, she, it bilan want ga -s qo'shiladi: She wants to swim. Would like o'zgarmaydi: She would like to swim. Would like dan keyin to + fe'l keladi.
forms: I / you / we / they + want to + play
He / she / it + wants to + play
I / he / she + would like to + play

examples.en: I want to play football after school.
examples.uz: Men maktabdan keyin futbol o'ynashni xohlayman.

examples.en: She wants to be a doctor.

mistakes.wrong: I would like have a drink.
mistakes.right: I would like to have a drink.
mistakes.note_uz: Would like dan keyin to kerak.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: My brother doesn't ___ to eat fish.

title: Let's... / Shall we...? / Can I...? (suggestions and requests)
rule_uz: Do'stlarga birga biror ish qilishni taklif qilamiz: Let's play! yoki Shall we play? Let's va Shall we dan keyin fe'l oddiy holida keladi. Ruxsat so'rash yoki iltimos qilish uchun Can I...? deymiz: Can I use your pen, please? Please so'zi iltimosni yanada yoqimli qiladi.
forms: Shall we + fe'l?: Shall we go?
Can I + fe'l?: Can I sit here?

examples.en: Shall we go to the zoo?
Can I have some water, please?

mistakes.wrong: Shall we going to the park?
mistakes.right: Shall we go to the park?
mistakes.note_uz: Shall we dan keyin fe'l oddiy holida turadi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: ___ I open the window? It is hot.
